pin.title: Graniph Cafe Kyoto Opens in Shijo Kawaramachi
pin.description: Graniph’s announced third-floor Kyoto cafe will serve local matcha collaborations, MAMIDORI sweets and REC COFFEE.
pin.address: 3F FUJII DAIMARU NORTH 3, 373 Naramono-cho, Shijo-dori Teramachi Nishiiru, Shimogyo-ku, Kyoto
